name: bu_Ti4O8
title: TiO2 (Ti4O8) crystal
description: Crystal structure prediction of TiO2 with 4 formula units per cell (rutile, anatase, brookite-like and high-pressure polymorphs compete). guard_factor 0.80: with the default guard (0.75) NEP89 has a dense collapsed phase (about 5.5 A^3/atom, Ti-Ti 2.21 A, O-O 1.2 A, 12-18 neighbours per Ti) about 1 eV below anatase; the stronger guard (Ti-Ti >= 2.56 A, Ti-O >= 1.81 A) removes it and is zero for rutile, anatase and brookite.
